reason: This is a large, cross-cutting refactor of core evaluation/build context abstractions (`EvalContext` / `BuildContext`) that propagates through expression evaluation, planner plan building, executor runtime, session/sessionctx plumbing, table behavior, and mock coprocessor paths. Changes of this shape can easily introduce high-severity semantic regressions around expression/type behavior, session-dependent evaluation, plan/runtime consistency, and table/executor correctness, so it is central and risky enough for a dedicated deep review.
